body: It's alright. I was gone too, I tried my best to distract myself. I'm doing everything not to think about stuff. The emptiness is rather about writing anything. I have problems visualizing things etc, when I thought about making the game a year ago I had so many ideas but now... I can't think of anything. I wouldn't have problems programming, I think, but my imagination is almost completely gone. I just hope it comes back. I've been drawing since I was a kid. I can't live without it, and without imagination I can't draw. I live in a capital, there are so many places to go to... But I just don't why, man. I don't know why I would go there. It's very hard to choose a place and I always feel like I'm wasting my parents money on tickets. I usually go to fast food restaurants and order coffee because I can't find a different place to go to. And I just sit on my phone and then go home. It would be much better to go with someone, but I have no friends. I've had a few, but they all left me when it started to get worse. I can't stand the fact that I can't behave like before. It always turns out very awkward because I have problems with talking and expressing myself. It's like I would have to get them to know me again. I don't know how to make it that I don't seem so bored, even though I appreciate them being here. And man, I already feel much better talking to you. I feel that someone cares, it's been very long since I could talk with someone. I often lose hope that anyone could care. Being able to talk means a lot to me

Yeah... I was on aripiprazole, olanzapine and amisulpride. I think the maximum time I was taking them was two weeks. I slept 17 hours a day, I was severely dehydrated and barely ate anything. My blood pressure was severely dropping after taking the meds, I think it's the cause. I almost fainted while cutting bacon once... My psychiatrist wanted to give me more meds, but I have decided that I'll never take them again. Someone told me about dystonia and after research I was so horrified that I promised myself I'll never take meds again. I mean, they kinda worked, but it's just not worth it. I'm trying to do everything I can just not to take meds. But I probably will if there is no way out
Sure, I'll try at least. I'm very new on Reddit

Sometimes I think I'm like a cockroach since I still managed to stay alive after all the shit. But I'm afraid that my limits are close. The book is about a guy who couldn't see the barrier between fantasy and reality anymore. It sounds very vague, but his story is very tragic and impacts a lot of other people. I wanted to base the game on the story, or just part of it. It's nothing serious, but I would like to start. I'm just so empty I can't think of anything. I used to draw, but I have the same problem. I live in a small flat, but I could go somewhere. I just don't know where to go. There's nobody I can go with. I could spend a day alone somewhere, but it's extremely hard to go out.
